name: West Texas Express Pipeline (Enbridge)
monitor_reason: concrete step: only a non-binding open season (Sept 10-25, 2026) so far; no binding commitments, FEED/EPC award, Texas Railroad Commission permit filing or FID found. Length (more than 150 mi) and sponsor (Enbridge) are sourced, so it passes the length and sponsor legs.
researcher_notes: Re-checked against the roster: not an existing row. Nearest rows are Comanche Trail P2519 (195 mi, 42 in, Waha to San Elizario, operating), Trans-Pecos P0268 (148 mi, Fort Stockton to Presidio), Saguaro Connector P5664 (proposed, 155 mi, 48 in, Pecos area) and Double E P0061. None is an Enbridge line. Three sources read in full: the Enbridge open season notice (9/10/2026) calls it a proposed greenfield intrastate gas pipeline from the Waha hub area to the greater El Paso area, with laterals to Hudspeth County and the US-Mexico border. Oil and Gas Journal (9/18/2026) states 2 bcfd, more than 150 miles of new 42-inch pipe, target in service Q4 2029, subject to commercial support and approvals; final capacity and routing depend on open season results. Pipeline and Gas Journal (9/15/2026) repeats the same figures. The three are one origin (the Enbridge announcement), so independence is weak. Intrastate, so FERC silence is expected; no Texas Railroad Commission filing found. Promote to new_row when a binding open season result, a permit filing or an FID is reported.
